summary: VEILFALL: Ashes of the Nine is an isometric multiplayer action RPG in a shared main realm, with a solo Veil title/menu place. Place and actor scripts run quests, combat, bosses and ambience; player/character modules handle the Bearer and persistence, while shared data and procedural scene scripts supply combat profiles, models, services and world dressing.
places: places/main/ - shared playable realm: Wayside Fire, Broken Lantern Road, Lanternmere, Hanging Orchard, Ashen Abbey, Ossuary and the Hollow Deep; cells hold authored landmarks, enemy packs and cave crystal dressing.
places/veil/ - solo ephemeral title/menu stage and ravine backdrop, configured as the default place; the active Bearer is parked here while menus are open.
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry: defaultPlace veil; attaches player/camera templates, lighting, arrival/nametag behaviors, controls and audio mix.
templates/player.js - player body with humanoid-locomotion.js and scripts/player.js, plus carried-light child.
templates/camera.js - custom camera template running scripts/camera.js.
places/main/config.yaml and places/main/cells/ - shared-realm atmosphere, terrain and authored areas; world.assets.yaml registers shared assets.
places/main/sim.js - main-place referee: NPC/services, quest stages, enemy packs, progression, boss lifecycle/reset and place music/ambience.
places/veil/config.yaml and places/veil/cells/ - solo title/menu scene and ambience; scripts/places/veil/sim.js supplies its menu soundtrack.
scripts/terrain.js - main realm height/material field; veilfall-map.js supplies the connected walkable region shapes and floor gates.
sim.js - world-level simulation entry; place-specific cadence/tick handlers live in places/*/sim.js.
shared: scripts/lib/character.js - Bearer schema, fresh state, roster/create/load/save/delete and packed position; player.js and arrival.js reuse it, crier/board-notes use realmOf.
scripts/db.js and scripts/lib/data/realms.yml - realm/character and trade schemas, realm routing/name registry, and guild-vault SQL table/index setup.
scripts/lib/data/combat.yml - combat/skill/enemy/boss profiles read by player.js, main sim, wax-pack.js and pack UI; includes Ossuary ash-dead and Hollow Deep enemy/mini-boss profiles.
scripts/lib/data/models.js - MODELS, HEIGHT and body map reusable character/enemy kinds to uploaded GLBs and metre heights; main sim and wax-pack reuse it.
scripts/lib/data/economy.yml with scripts/lib/coins.js - copper denominations, enemy drops, rewards, sale values and stock shared by combat, sim, shop, HUD and crier.
scripts/lib/data/loot.yml and scripts/lib/loot.js - gear/drop/forge rules, rolls, boss marks, crafting and gear stats for combat, pack UI and trade; rows cover the new Ossuary and Deep kinds.
scripts/lib/data/veilfall-map.js - shared chapter region geometry, floor distances and zone naming used by terrain, player movement/gates and main sim.

scripts/lib/character.js, scripts/lib/pack-ui.js, scripts/lib/shop.js and scripts/lib/trade.js - common Bearer and service logic; guildvault.js owns shared vault mutations and board-ui.js shares trade reads.
notableExports: scripts/player.js - onSpawn, onInput, boltLand, crosswoundFall, update; delayed projectile impacts and Crosswound cleave route through handlers.
scripts/lib/data/models.js - MODELS, HEIGHT, body; HEIGHT values in metres position attached enemy effects.
scripts/wax-pack.js - roll, telegraph, hurtPlayers, payout, update; shared ordinary-enemy AI and combat/payout helpers.
scripts/ui.js - default state-driven HUD/menu/sheets, talent tree, unit frames and enemy portrait/name lookup; scripts/ui/nametag.js - nametag renderer.
scripts/abbess.js, bailiff.js, ringer.js, warden.js, hangman.js - boss handlers; crier.js exports onSpawn, quiet, update.
scripts/lib/character.js - CHAR_KEYS, fresh, START, realmOf, pack, zoneOf, roster, create/load/save/remove; scripts/lib/data/talents.js exports talent definitions and stat helpers.
scripts/gen/deep-crystal.js - geometry, collider; parametric seeded violet crystal cluster with a rock base for Hollow Deep cells.
ownership: scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS - persistent Bearer combat/progression, quest/reward claims, inventory/gear, arts, attuned shrines, personal vault/vaultRows and talents; packed position and zone feed re-entry/menu context.

scripts/player.js - active-body movement/combat/death, class attacks and skill timers, menu/options scratch, floor gates, inventory/service actions and derived gear stats; proximity flags and service reads are transient.
places/main/sim.js - quest/dialog/cut progress and claims; hub NPC/service spawning, packs and boss lifecycle/reset, respawn rows, place mood/track index and ambient audio.
scripts/wax-pack.js - ordinary and mini-boss enemy AI/hp/casts/death, half-health summons and eligible Bearers' XP, copper, kills, shards and gear-drop inboxes.

scripts/bailiff.js, ringer.js, warden.js, hangman.js and abbess.js - respective boss hp/phases/casts/adds/defeat and participant/place boss rows; boss handlers write lastFall and first world trophy records.
scripts/ui.js - presentation derived from player state and nearby foe state; foe labels and portraits include ash-dead and Hollow Deep kinds.
scripts/lib/guildvault.js and guild_vault SQL rows - shared items keyed by realm and Spawn guild; taken rows are guarded, and character inventory owns the member's copy.
places/main/cells/x0z-2.scene and x0z-3.scene - authored deep-dress crystal instances reference scripts/gen/deep-crystal.js; scene files own placement, params and seeds, not generator geometry.
flows: world.config.yaml attaches player through templates/player.js and maps actions; UI menu actions → scripts/player.js routes title/realm/character/create/enter/logout/options/notes.
defaultPlace veil → player menu; player.js menuInput → character.js roster/create/load/remove; realms.yml routes the selection and Bearer fields hydrate player.state.
While player.state.menu is set, player.js hides the body and moves it to solo place veil; scripts/places/veil/sim.js plays/rotates the menu playlist unless a Bearer is on main.
world controls and controls.js select world/menu touch surfaces; ui.js actions → player.js and its service handlers.
player.js periodically/on rest saves changed CHAR_KEYS plus packed position → character.js writes characters; arrival.js saves an active Bearer leaving main.
player.js derives chapter floor gates from quest stage/abbeyOpenAll → veilfall-map.js floorDist governs goals and movement; Ossuary access gates the appended Hollow Deep via deepDist.
places/main/sim.js quest state advances from player talk/kills/boss flags; chapter stages, boss defeat and service interactions drive shared realm progression.
places/main/sim.js PACKS + combat.yml profiles + models.js body/HEIGHT → enemySpec spawns wax-pack actors; wax-pack runs combat, respawn and eligible payouts/drops using combat/economy/loot data.
Main sim PACKS → Ossuary ashrevenant/cinderthrall/pyrepriest and Kiln Warden; Hollow Deep deepghoul/lurker/crystalbrute and Broodmother; profile summon rows drive mini-boss adds.
Enemy kinds in wax-pack state → ui.js foe labels, portraits and elite/mini-boss frames; main sim selects soul, sap, ember or violet crystal FX by kind family.
Main sim TRACKS/rest-zone mood + fight/elite/boss state → room music playlist; duration (or 150s fallback) advances the track index, and place sim spawns ambience beds/distant sounds.

Boss defeat → participant flags/place.state.lastFall → crier heralds; boss handlers write world.state.trophies[boss] → trophies.js derives relic/plaque visibility; nearby service state → pack/shop/trade/vault panels and mutations.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/hub-*.js - reusable Wayside Fire props varied by instance params, seed and scene transform; share hub-kit.js; hub-board.js also serves Candlehold's exchange board.
scripts/gen/vf-*.js and vf-ruin.js - Broken Lantern Road landmarks/clutter and road, arena, Wax Veil approach and Abbey forms vary by params, dimensions and seed; most share vf-kit.js.
scripts/gen/fen-*.js - Lanternmere terrain dressing, path, waystones, stump/tree/props and heart structures are parametric seeded scene generators; share fen-kit.js where applicable.
scripts/gen/cap-kit.js with cap-gate.js, cap-house.js and cap-wall.js - Candlehold stone, timber and slate share local-frame helpers; dimensions, lighting and seed vary by instance.
scripts/gen/veil-land.js and veil-shrine.js - Veil ledge/cliff/ridge structures vary by kind/dimensions; shrine exports structure/hook constants.
scripts/gen/arena-floor.js, arena-pillar.js, gibbet.js and toll-throne.js - Bailiff arena dressing shares scripts/gen/shapes.js and wax palette; split gibbet cages render separately at a top pivot.
scripts/gen/deep-crystal.js - seeded, parametric cave-crystal clusters vary by spear count, height and spread; x0z-2.scene and x0z-3.scene place them as static deep-dress.

scripts/wax-pack.js + combat.yml + models.js - shared enemy movement, attack, death and payout vary by kind; Wax, drowned, Blood Woods, Spires, Ossuary and Deep kinds use kind-specific bodies, FX, VO, profiles and loot.
probableOrphans: scripts/gen/wax-figure.js - legacy procedural wax-figure generator; current wax actors use registered models.js bodies.
migrationNotes: Persistent character data is scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS plus packed position; talents, shrines, vault and vaultRows persist per Bearer, while proximity flags and vault UI reads are transient.

Talent IDs are branch-tier strings b-t; each earlier tier requires 3 points spent in that branch, capstones have one rank with fourfold stat value, and talent changes must invalidate derived gear stats.
Wayshrine IDs/coordinates in combat.yml must stay aligned with scene IDs/locations; travel costs 10 copper and refuses while an enemy is within 10 m; Abbey destination obeys player gate.
Personal vault is 18 slots plus up to three purchased rows of nine; guild vault is 27 shared slots per Spawn guild per realm in SQL, separate from character inventory.
Enemy kind must stay aligned across main sim PACKS, combat.yml, models.js MODELS/HEIGHT, loot.yml/economy.yml, wax-pack.js and ui.js labels/portraits; HEIGHT is metres and positions attached FX.
Boss-like wax-pack kinds use elite tagging and the shared wax enemy handler; half-health adds are profile-driven, while only designated main bosses use their separate boss handlers.
